approach: Add a pure module crates/athena-core/src/scope_guard.rs with input structs (AttemptRecord, RequestRecord), line grouping by union-find over retry_of and quotes links, named threshold constants, one function per signal T1..T5, and evaluate_before_attempt(line, forecast_p90) returning all five results. Tests replay the four section 5.1 cases from hand-built records. Then flip D127 to accepted in decisions.md, update scope-guard.md status, section 8 and section 13, and add a CHANGELOG entry. No I/O, no clock, no wiring.

decisions.choice: Signal results use enums: Level {None, Flag, Pause} for T1, T2, T3, T5; T4 returns Match {No, Maybe, Yes}, mapped to None, Flag, Pause.
decisions.reason: Section 5 gives flag and pause effects, and T4 maybe must flag without pausing.

rejected.why: Cannot express flag versus pause or the T4 maybe.

decisions.choice: T4 compares normalised unmet-criterion text (lower case, ASCII digits removed, whitespace collapsed) of the last two rejections. Equal gives Yes; containment or majority word overlap, or a missing criterion, gives Maybe; else No.
decisions.reason: Section 5 rule, with unclear matches flagged not paused; the Maybe rule is simple and documented.

rejected.why: That is T1; the same-criterion rule would not exist to remove.
More code and tuning, a model's job (section 6).

decisions.choice: Time, spend and forecast p90 are struct fields or arguments; no clock, fs or process.
decisions.reason: Criterion 4; the later watcher supplies values from records.

rejected.why: Couples the pure module to I/O types.

decisions.choice: Evaluate before attempt n from finished attempts only; T1 fires when finished attempts >= 2.

rejected.option: Include the pending attempt in the input
rejected.why: Invents a record that does not exist yet.

rejected.why: Other text refers to job numbers.

risks.mitigation: Avoid banned words and email-like text; run cargo test --locked.

demonstrations.method: Run unit tests trailer_*, speedup_*, prompt_budget_*, cut_a_* that build records and assert levels per evaluation point.
demonstrations.observes: All pass; speedup T4 Pause after 2nd rejection; cut A T1 Flag, no Pause; prompt-budget T5 Flag at 60 min, none at 59.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the signal functions, no T4 Pause after the 2nd speedup rejection and the asserted levels would not hold.

demonstrations.method: A different-criteria test asserts T4 not Pause; the speedup test asserts Pause on same criterion with differing numbers.
demonstrations.observes: Both pass; always-true comparison fails the different-criteria test, always-false fails the speedup test.
demonstrations.fails_without: The different-criteria test fails if the same-criterion comparison is removed or always true.

demonstrations.method: Grouping, normalisation and maybe tests, plus reading the named constants in source.
demonstrations.observes: Request, retry and quoting request form one line, unrelated does not; 'Under 7 minutes' equals 'under 12 MINUTES'; Maybe flags without pausing; constants T1_ATTEMPT=3, T2_RATIO=1.5, T2_PLANNING_ROUND=3, T3_FLAG_RATIO=1.0, T3_PAUSE_RATIO=1.5, T3_LINE_DOLLARS=5.0, T4_REJECTIONS=2, T5_FLAG_MINUTES=60, T5_PAUSE_MINUTES=120 exist.
demonstrations.fails_without: Grouping test fails if links are ignored; maybe test fails if a maybe paused.

demonstrations.method: Compile with the export line, and read the source for forbidden APIs.
demonstrations.observes: Compiles with pub mod scope_guard; in lib.rs; no std::fs, process, net, SystemTime or Instant in the file.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the export the module is unreachable from the crate and the later watcher cannot call it; an I/O call would show in the source read.

demonstrations.observes: Status accepted, decider the brain under Sri's delegation (BRIEF.md addenda of 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-25), both changes recorded.
Status line accepted; section 8 says whoever holds Sri's delegation; section 13 starts with jobs 1 and 5 (rules only); CHANGELOG Unreleased Added has an entry.

demonstrations.method: Run clippy, then cargo fmt --all --check and cargo test --locked across the workspace.
demonstrations.observes: Clippy and fmt report nothing; every workspace test passes, including the boundary scan and budget tests over the edited docs and the new scope_guard tests.
demonstrations.fails_without: Clippy exits non-zero on any warning in the new module, fmt --check fails on unformatted code, and cargo test --locked fails if a scope_guard test, the boundary scan or a budget test fails.

open_questions: The T4 maybe rule (containment or majority-word overlap) is a producer choice; the design says only 'unclear'.
A rejected attempt with no recorded unmet criterion is assumed Maybe; the design does not say.
Cut A and trailer per-attempt figures are even splits; cut A criteria text is invented for tests.
